## Release Note: Orbit Scheduler 2.4.0

Orbit Scheduler now supports calendar-aware scheduling with business day and holiday recognition. This release caps exponential back-off at 30 seconds and fixes a critical jitter bug that could schedule jobs in the past. Node 16 support has been dropped; Node 18+ is now required. The scheduling team recommends upgrading to benefit from improved reliability and scheduling flexibility.
